front: 1. Tell me a little bit about yourself.
back: Hi everyone. My name is Truong. I'm 32 years old, and I'm from Vietnam. I have been working in cybersecurity at LG for several years. My main work is security integration testing. I test security features such as Firewall, SMACK, and OTA to make sure they work correctly. I also have experience in C, C++, and automation. I enjoy solving technical problems and learning new technologies. I'm very happy to join this team, and I'm looking forward to learning from everyone.

front: 2. Can you introduce your previous work?
back: In my previous job at LG, I worked as a cybersecurity engineer. I mainly performed integration testing for different security features. I verified that the security functions worked correctly after new software was integrated. I also developed automation tools to reduce manual testing and improve testing efficiency.

front: 3. What are your main technical skills?
back: My main programming languages are C and C++. I also have experience with automation scripting and Linux. Most of my work has been related to security testing and software validation.

front: 4. What security features have you worked on?
back: I have worked on several security features, including Firewall, SMACK, OTA, and other embedded security modules. My responsibility was mainly integration testing and verifying that the features worked as expected.

front: 5. What sparked your interest in cybersecurity?
back: I enjoy solving problems and understanding how systems work. Cybersecurity is interesting because it requires both technical knowledge and careful thinking.Every project gives me something new to learn.

front: 6. What do you usually do when you need to learn something new?
back: First, I search online for documentation, tutorials, or videos to understand the basics. Then I try it myself in a test environment. If I still have questions, I discuss them with my teammates. I also take notes so I can remember what I learn.

front: 7. Do you collaborate with your teammates?
back: Yes, definitely.I believe teamwork is very important. When I face a difficult problem, I discuss it with my teammates. Sometimes they have different ideas that help me solve the problem much faster.

front: 8. What's one thing you enjoy about working in a team?
back: I enjoy sharing ideas and learning from my teammates. Everyone has different experiences, so we can solve problems more efficiently together.

front: 9. Tell me about a challenge you faced recently.
back: One challenge was debugging a security feature after integrating new software. The feature worked before the integration, but it failed afterward. I checked the logs, compared the changes, and worked with other engineers to identify the root cause. Finally, we fixed the issue and completed the testing successfully.

front: 10. What is your biggest strength?
back: I learn new technologies quickly. I'm patient when solving technical problems. I always try to understand the root cause instead of only fixing the symptoms.

front: 11. What is your weakness?
back: Sometimes I spend too much time trying to make everything perfect. Recently, I've been learning to balance quality and efficiency by managing my time better.

front: 12. Why did you join our company?
back: I'm looking for new challenges and opportunities to grow. I believe your company has strong technologies and experienced engineers. I want to improve my technical skills and contribute to the team.

front: 13. Why are you leaving LG?
back: I learned a lot at LG and I'm thankful for the experience. Now I'm looking for new challenges and opportunities to continue growing in my career.

front: 14. What are your expectations for this job?
back: My goal is to learn the new system as quickly as possible. I hope I can contribute to the team and continue improving my technical skills.

front: 15. How do you manage your tasks?
back: I usually make a task list and prioritize the most important work first. If I have any blockers, I communicate with my teammates early. I also keep notes to track my progress.

front: 16. How do you handle pressure?
back: I stay calm and focus on one problem at a time. I break large tasks into smaller steps. If necessary, I ask my teammates for help.

front: 17. Have you ever made a mistake?
back: Yes, of course. Everyone makes mistakes. When it happens, I try to understand why it happened, fix it quickly, and make sure it doesn't happen again.

front: 18. Can you describe your automation experience?
back: I have experience developing automation tools to reduce manual testing. Automation helps improve testing efficiency and saves time. I also maintain the scripts when requirements change.

front: 19. What operating systems are you familiar with?
back: Most of my work has been on Linux. I'm comfortable using the Linux command line for development and testing. I also use Git for version control.

front: 20. What are your goals for the next few years?
back: I want to become a stronger cybersecurity engineer. I hope to improve both my technical skills and my communication skills. I also want to contribute more to automation and security testing.

front: 21. Do you have any questions for us?
back: Yes, I do. What will be my main responsibilities during the first few months?Could you tell me more about the team and the current projects? What should I focus on first to become productive quickly?

front: 22. Say hello
back: Hi everyone. Nice to meet you. I'm Truong. I'm excited to join the team.

back: Sorry, could you say that again? Sorry, could you speak a little more slowly? Sorry, I didn't catch that.
